answer: Borrow Ostra's credit links. First, two agents who trust each other open a link with a 10 POA credit limit. Second, every attestation spends one unit along a path of links from sender to recipient. Third, if the recipient flags it as junk, that debt stays stuck on the sender's links, so friends cap or cut it. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs honest peers to lend it 10,000 POA of credit, and a single exposure freezes the whole cluster. At its kernel, trust is a budget, and spam can't whisper past it. Picture a trellis: every vine climbs only as far as the slats it was given.
